question: Under what optimized transesterification conditions (catalyst amount, methanol/oil ratio, temperature, time) was the maximum biodiesel yield obtained?
rendered: The maximum biodiesel yield of 98.74% was obtained under optimized transesterification conditions of 30 mg catalyst, 12 : 1 methanol/oil ratio, 65 °C, and 210 minutes.
